role: A 'domain:path' name for an asset or a registry entry. In play the only values that matter are the 'minecraft:...' registry names of blocks and items.

members.name: resourceDomain
members.note: the native tables store the whole 'minecraft:stone' string, domain and path together

members.name: ResourceLocation
members.note: the 'domain:path' split is baked into the generated names

members.name: equals
members.note: name comparison in C is strcmp on the full string

notes: Texture atlas entries in the renderer are looked up by plain names (for example 'destroy_stage_0' in raster_overlay.c), not by ResourceLocation. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): runtime registry replaced by the generated blocks.h/items.h tables; nothing registers at runtime. Formerly listed as missing: No ResourceLocation type: registry names are plain 'minecraft:...' strings in the generated tables; the asset-loading side (textures, sounds, lang) is not part of the native engine.
